title: The Prestige
synopsis: Two magicians, a transported man, a tank of water, and a notebook that may be telling the truth or the better lie.

nodes.text: A trick gone wrong on a stage in front of strangers.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Tie a slipknot.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Reckless.

nodes.text: A coffin, a brother, a hard look across an open grave.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: You sit at last in front of a small girl who calls you Daddy and does not know which of you that is. You hold her hand. You agree, both of you, that it is.
Audiences fill the theater for a year. They want to be fooled. You give them their money's worth, again and again, until the lie wears thin and you sleep.
You publish the notebook. Magic, in your city, dies a little. So do you. So does Angier, in his way. The next century will reinvent both.
